tools.name: get_security_metrics
tools.title: Get stock or ETF performance and risk
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how a single US stock or ETF has performed or how risky it is: YTD, 1-year and 5-year annualized returns, max drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha and dividend yield, with a 1Y/5Y chart. End-of-day data for US large and mid caps, major foreign stocks and US ETFs. Not for intraday quotes, news, earnings, fundamentals or price targets.

ticker.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, VOO or BRK.B

asOf.description: Market date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the latest close behind every number

maxDrawdown1yPct.description: Worst peak-to-trough fall over the past year (negative)

beta1y.description: Versus SPY, from daily returns over the past year

volatility1yPct.description: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns over the past year

dividendYieldPct.description: Trailing 12-month dividend yield: dividends that went ex in the past year over the latest close. 0 pays none; null when unknown (paid in another currency)

statsSince.description: YYYY-MM-DD, set only when there is less than a year of history: the 1Y figures (return, drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, beta, alpha, yield) then run from this first close, and so does the YTD return if it falls this year. Screens on those metrics leave such securities out

comparisons.description: Popular Redstone comparisons for this ticker

tools.name: compare_securities
tools.title: Compare stocks or ETFs
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare 2 to 5 US stocks or ETFs side by side (e.g. "VOO vs QQQ", "SCHD or VYM?"): returns, drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, beta, dividend yield and how correlated they are, with an overlaid 1Y/5Y chart. End-of-day data for US large and mid caps, major foreign stocks and US ETFs. Not for intraday quotes or recommendations on what to buy.

tools.name: backtest_portfolio
tools.title: Backtest a stock and ETF portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the user describes a portfolio of US stocks and ETFs with weights (e.g. "60% VTI, 40% BND", "equal parts AAPL, MSFT, NVDA") and wants to know how it would have done or how risky it is: returns over YTD, 1 year and 5 years (rebalanced quarterly), max drawdown, volatility, Sharpe, beta vs SPY, dividend yield and the correlation between holdings, charted against SPY, with a link that opens it on Redstone to save. 2 to 20 holdings. Not for live brokerage accounts, trading or allocation advice.

tools.name: screen_securities
tools.title: Screen stocks and ETFs by performance and risk
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a ranked list of US stocks or ETFs by a performance, risk or dividend yield metric, optionally within a sector or ETF category (e.g. "lowest volatility dividend ETFs", "highest yielding bond ETFs", "highest Sharpe tech stocks this year", "energy stocks with the smallest drawdown"). Covers about 2,900 US-listed stocks and about 1,200 US ETFs, end-of-day. Not for fundamentals (P/E, revenue), news or buy recommendations.

type.description: Limit to stocks, ETFs, or both

sector.description: Case-insensitive match on a stock's GICS sector (e.g. Information Technology, Health Care, Energy, Financials) or an ETF's category (e.g. Dividend, Bonds, Treasury, Large Cap Growth, Emerging Markets, Gold)

sortBy.description: Metric to rank by. For lowest risk, sort volatility1yPct ascending, maxDrawdown1yPct descending (closest to 0) or beta1y ascending

filters.description: Optional bounds in each metric's own units, e.g. {metric: 'beta1y', max: 1}. maxDrawdown1yPct is negative, so a drawdown smaller than 20% is {metric: 'maxDrawdown1yPct', min: -20}

tools.name: search_portfolios
tools.title: Find shared and model portfolios
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see real portfolios to learn from or copy (e.g. "show me low-drawdown dividend portfolios", "portfolios that hold SCHD", "the best risk-adjusted portfolios on Redstone"): the public portfolios Redstone's users built and shared, and Redstone's model portfolios, with past-year returns, risk and yield. Describe the kind of portfolio with the figure filters where one fits; nameIncludes only matches names, so keep it for themes no figure captures, such as "AI". Up to 10 results. Not for the user's own brokerage account or for recommending a portfolio to buy.

nameIncludes.description: Words to look for in portfolio names, e.g. 'dividend' or 'AI'; any one matching is enough

items.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, VOO or BRK.B

madeBy.description: community: portfolios users built and shared; redstone: Redstone's model portfolios

maxDrawdownNoWorseThanPct.description: Keep portfolios whose worst fall over the past year was no deeper than this, e.g. -10

order.description: desc puts the highest first; for drawdown the highest is the shallowest
